definitions.gloss: latter period, second half, late stage
definitions.explanation: The later portion of a time period, era, or process. Used in academic, historical, and scheduling contexts to refer to the second half of a divided period.

examples.japanese: {後期|こうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十月|じゅうがつ}→十月：00634_juugatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧{後期|こうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。
examples.english: Culture flourished in the late Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妊娠|にんしん}→妊娠：12227_ninshin⟧{後期|こうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Once you enter the late stage of pregnancy, the physical burden increases.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly paired with ⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧ (first half/early period). In universities, ⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧/{後期|こうき} often correspond to the first and second semesters. In historical writing, it marks the later portion of an era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後期|こうき}⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧: latter-stage course
- {後期|こうき}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: second-semester exam
- {後期|こうき}⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧: person aged 75 or older (official term)
- 〜⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧{後期|こうき}: the late ... period
